title: Large-Library Query, Pagination & Lazy Retrieval
objective: Define indexed search/filter/sort/pagination and bounded lazy loading for reusable-resource catalogs, proving representative 1k/10k/50k synthetic tiers without requiring whole-library memory residency.

owner_sequence_authorization.source: Explicit owner instruction in this execution on 2026-09-10
owner_sequence_authorization.rule: Execute strictly in order; each unit retains its own bounded scope, validation, integration, closeout, and strict-successor selection.

selection_boundaries: ARI-14 is completed_verified and owns semantic tags, collections and family grouping only.
ARI-15 may implement indexed search/filter/sort/pagination and bounded lazy retrieval only after its own governed start.
Large-library retrieval must preserve ARI resource identity, provenance and ARI-11 rights/use-capability filtering; catalog scale must not grant new content or provider authority.
ARI-16 MAI bridge work and all later ARI implementation remain inactive until ARI-15 is completed_verified.
next_action: On the next execution Continue, governed-start ARI-15 only and carry it through its bounded large-library query/pagination/lazy-retrieval gate before advancing to ARI-16.
